cases.sentence: Я встану на стражу, поднимусь на крепостные ___.
cases.explain: The preposition на with accusative indicates direction or movement onto.

cases.sentence: Тогда Господь ответил, «Запиши ___, выведи на табличках».
cases.explain: The direct object of the verb Запиши (write) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Ведь еще не время ему исполниться, оно говорит о ___ и не обманет.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Если покажется, что медлит, жди, оно сбудется, не ___.
cases.explain: The future tense verb задержится (will delay/be late) matches the context of waiting for the vision to come.

cases.sentence: Они разверзают пасть, как мир мертвых, и как смерть они ненасытны к ___.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) with a prepositional sense uses prepositional case in older Russian texts, but modern usage varies.

cases.sentence: Они покоряют себе все народы, все племена подчиняют своему ___.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) with the dative case shows the direction of the action.

cases.sentence: Горе тому, кто копит чужое добро, кто богатеет на взятом в ___.
cases.explain: The preposition в with the accusative indicates into what the money is taken.

cases.sentence: Что за польза от идола, которого сделал ___?
cases.explain: The subject of the clause requires nominative case.

reading.ru: Я встану на стражу, поднимусь на крепостные валы.
reading.question: What does Habakkuk say he will do?
options: Stand at his watch and set himself on the ramparts
reading.correct: Stand at his watch and set himself on the ramparts
reading.explain: The prophet says 'I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts.'

reading.ru: Ведь еще не время ему исполниться, оно говорит о конце и не обманет.
reading.question: What does the vision say about the end?
options: It speaks of the end and will not lie
reading.correct: It speaks of the end and will not lie
reading.explain: The vision is said to speak of the end and will not prove false.

reading.ru: Посмотри на надменных, их дух неправеден, а праведный верой жив будет.
reading.question: How will the righteous live?
reading.explain: The text states 'the righteous will live by his faith.'

reading.ru: Вино обманывает этих гордецов и не дает им покоя.
reading.question: What does wine do to the arrogant?
reading.explain: The text says 'Wine is treacherous to the arrogant and gives them no rest.'

reading.ru: Горе тому, кто копит чужое добро, кто богатеет на взятом в долг.
reading.question: What is condemned in this verse?
options: Gathering what is not theirs and becoming rich through debt
reading.correct: Gathering what is not theirs and becoming rich through debt
reading.explain: The verse pronounces woe on those who collect what is not theirs and enrich themselves by extortion.

reading.ru: А Господь в святом храме Своем, пусть молчит вся земля перед Ним.
reading.question: Where is the Lord and what should all the earth do?
options: In His holy temple, and all the earth should be silent
In the heavens, and should praise Him
On the earth, and should worship
In the temple, and should sacrifice
reading.correct: In His holy temple, and all the earth should be silent
reading.explain: The text concludes 'But Yahweh is in His holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before Him.'
